onboarding.title: Getting Started
onboarding.resetDescription: Shows the guided tour, checklist, and tips again.
onboarding.resetConfirmMessage: This will restart onboarding and show the tour and checklist again.

tour.welcomeText: Welcome to ContractAI Review. This quick tour will show you the key features for reviewing contracts with AI-powered assistance.
tour.createWorkspaceText: Click here to create a new workspace where you can organize your contracts and collaborate with your team.
tour.uploadDocumentText: Use this button to upload your contract files. Supported formats include PDF, DOCX, and images.
tour.exportDocumentText: Download your documents and files from here. You can export individual files or processed outputs.
tour.exportNoFiles: Upload a file first to see the download button. Once you have files, you can export them from the Files tab.
tour.workspacesText: Create workspaces to organize your contracts. Each workspace can have multiple documents and team members.
tour.documentsText: Upload contracts (PDF, DOCX) and the AI will parse and index them for retrieval and analysis.
tour.chatText: Ask questions about your contract. The AI uses RAG to cite specific clauses and provide evidence-based answers.
tour.redlineText: Select text and generate suggested changes using different playbooks (Balanced, Conservative, Client-friendly).
tour.settingsText: Configure retention, parsers, and AI prompts per workspace.
tour.doneText: Use the checklist to track your progress. You can reset onboarding anytime from Account Settings.
tour.documentsNoWorkspace: Create your first workspace to see documents here.
tour.chatNoDocument: Create a document and upload a file to use the AI chat.
tour.redlineNoDocument: Create a document to use the redline feature.

ctx.documentsListText: Create documents to organize your contract files.
ctx.documentsListCardsText: Click any document to view, chat, and apply redlines.
ctx.wsSettingsRetentionText:
File Retention: How long uploaded PDFs/DOCX stay before automatic deletion (1–365 days).

A daily purge applies these limits; deletions are permanent.
ctx.wsSettingsRetentionTextEmbeddingsText: How long extracted text and RAG vectors are kept (1–730 days). After OCR/parsing, this controls retention of the indexed content used for search and chat.
ctx.wsSettingsRetentionFuzzyMatchText: Threshold (0–100%) for matching contract text when applying redlines. Higher values require more exact matches; lower values allow fuzzier suggestions.
ctx.wsSettingsChunkingText: Configure chunking strategy for how documents are split for RAG.
ctx.wsSettingsParsersText: Enable and configure parsers (PDF, DOCX, etc.) and API keys.
ctx.wsSettingsPromptsText: Customize AI prompts for chat and redline by workspace.
ctx.membersTableText: Manage roles: Owner, Admin, Member, Viewer.
ctx.privacyNologsText: Enable no-logs mode to minimize stored data.
ctx.auditTableText: All workspace actions are logged here.
ctx.auditFiltersText: Filter by action, user, date, or target type.
ctx.accountOnboardingText: Restart the tour or reset onboarding anytime.
ctx.accountDangerText: Delete your account permanently from here.

confidenceScore.title: Confidence score
confidenceScore.short: How certain the AI is based on similar clauses and evidence coverage.
confidenceScore.long1: Confidence is derived from retrieval similarity, citation coverage, and rule checks.
confidenceScore.long2: Use it as a guide, not legal advice.
confidenceScore.long3: Low confidence means you should review sources more carefully.

retention.title: Retention Settings
retention.description: Retention settings determine how long data will be kept before being permanently deleted. Only OWNER and ADMIN can modify these settings.
retention.fileRetentionDescription: Files will be automatically deleted after this period (1-365 days)
retention.mustBeBetween: Value must be between 1 and 365 days
retention.defaultTextEmbeddingsRetentionDays: Default Text and Embeddings Retention Days
retention.textEmbeddingsRetentionDescription: Extracted texts and embeddings will be automatically deleted after this period (1-730 days)
retention.mustBeBetweenText: Value must be between 1 and 730 days

importantItems.permanent: Data will be permanently deleted after the retention period
importantItems.calculated: Retention is calculated from the file/document creation date

retention.fuzzyMatchThresholdDescription: Minimum match percentage (0-100) for fuzzy text matching when applying redlines. Higher values require more exact matches.

transcription.preferredProviderHint: Choose which provider to use for voice transcription. If unset, the first provider with a configured key is used.
transcription.apiKeysDescription: Add your Hugging Face or OpenAI API key to enable voice transcription in the chat. Keys are encrypted and shared with all workspace members.

tts.planHint: Free: MP3 output. Pro and above: WAV, more voices.

chunking.description: Choose how document text is split into chunks for AI retrieval. Paragraph-based chunking preserves legal clause boundaries and is recommended for contracts.
chunking.strategyHint: Only Paragraph, Sentence, and Fixed-size are available. Semantic and Agentic will be available in a future update.
